method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 13 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: I spoke to seven physics experts grappling with the AI revolution
picks.author: Dan Kagan-Kans
picks.why_it_matters: A private theoretical-physics benchmark saturated before release, and physicists explain what AI does to calculation, the arXiv flood and training the next generation.

picks.title: What Makes Up the Cosmos? A 20-Year Survey Hints That Something Is Missing.
picks.author: Charlie Wood
picks.why_it_matters: Twenty years of Dark Energy Survey data, combined with DESI, now strain Lambda-CDM; explains what the cracks in the standard model of cosmology look like.

picks.title: Jennifer Croft on the Efficient Intimacy of Postcards
picks.author: Jennifer Croft
picks.why_it_matters: A history of the postcard, from a rejected 1865 postal proposal to a personal story, argues that brevity and exposure create intimacy.

picks.title: Can Robots Bring Stroke Surgery to Remote Hospitals?
picks.author: Max G. Levy
picks.why_it_matters: Shows how a steerable robotic catheter and computer-vision tracking turn blind stroke surgery into remote control, and why the bottleneck is evidence and infrastructure.

picks.title: Marginal Grains
picks.why_it_matters: Traces wheat from shattering rachises and genome hybridizations to modern breeding, showing how domestication and selection built the crop that feeds civilization.
